newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Widow of Albania's Hoxha released from Tirana jail. [CORRECTED 10:49 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Widow of Albania's Hoxha released from Tirana jail. [CORRECTED 10:49 GMT]

text.p: The 76-year-old widow of the late Albanian Stalinist dictator Enver Hoxha was released from a Tirana jail on Friday, witnesses said. (Corrects age from 74-year-old to 76-year-old.)

"I am very pleased to be out but I am now rushing off to see my children and family," Nexhmije Hoxha told reporters upon her release. She was jailed in 1993 for 11 years on embezzlement charges but her term was reduced three times on the orders of President Sali Berisha.
Berisha swept to power in March 1992 in a landslide win over the Socialists, reformed heirs to the communists.
"I don't know where I'm going to live because I have no home," Nexhmije Hoxha said. Her two sons and a nephew were waiting to meet her at the gates of the capital's top security prison.
Enver Hoxha ruled Europe's poorest country with an iron fist for four decades until his death in April 1985. Albania toppled communism in December 1990 after a popular uprising.

Nexhmije Hoxha was found guilty in May 1993 of spending tens of thousands of dollars on personal Western luxuries and foreign travel while the majority of the country's three million people lived in abject poverty.
